name: Unify
tagline: A single conversational GTM agent for warm outbound — self-serve from $0, built to augment a seller rather than replace one.
verdict: Unify fills a real, previously under-served position in this category's GTM-outbound cluster: cheaper and far more transparent than Clay's usage-based ($167+/month) enrichment canvas, and self-serve where 11x and Artisan are both entirely custom-quoted and sales-gated. It explicitly positions itself as a productivity layer for a human seller rather than an autonomous replacement, wrapping list-building, enrichment, signal-based prioritization and sequencing into one chat-based agent instead of a spreadsheet-style workflow builder. The catch: it just completed a dramatic pricing-model pivot — several third-party sources published within the last few months still describe a completely different enterprise-only motion — so treat pricing found outside unifygtm.com/pricing itself as potentially stale, and its deepest features (GPT-5.5, write-access CRM sync, website intent signals) still sit behind a custom Business tier. Pick Unify if you want an accessible, self-serve GTM agent that augments a rep rather than replacing one; skip it if you specifically want Clay's build-your-own depth or 11x/Artisan's fully autonomous outbound motion.
